amendment_reason: Field simplification approved: verified base area is the standard infiltration area; stage-area is optional advanced; evaporation uses 12 monthly mean daily mm/day values.

water_routes.route_name: New surface/partly-surface structure — annual rainfall-subjected water potential
water_routes.eligibility: Surface/partly surface; not fully lined farm pond; timing classification resolves to KPI 1.1.1
water_routes.capacity_basis: silt-adjusted eligible net capacity; first monsoon after construction uses 0% silt
water_routes.infiltration_required: True — verified base area + infiltration rate for standard route
water_routes.evaporation_required: True — monthly mean daily evaporation + proportional area
water_routes.result_logic: daily water balance; KPI 1.1.1 = cumulative infiltration + final closing storage; cross-check captured runoff - cumulative evaporation
water_routes.standard_evaporation_area_method: Proportional full surface area × daily fill fraction
water_routes.evaporation_rate_input: 12 monthly mean daily evaporation values, mm/day; use calendar month value for each simulation day
water_routes.stage_area_requirement: Optional advanced only; not required for standard field route

infiltration.formula: Potential infiltration = Verified Base Area (m2) × Infiltration Rate (mm/hour) × 24 / 1000
infiltration.advanced: stage-area curve, only when explicitly selected and complete
infiltration.missing_default: If neither verified base area nor an explicitly selected valid advanced method exists, affected KPI 1.1.1 route is not calculation-ready.

evaporation.rate_input: 12 monthly mean daily evaporation values in mm/day
evaporation.daily_rate_selection: Use the value for the calendar month of each simulation date; 29 February uses the February value.
evaporation.full_surface_area_source: Use measured full surface area when supplied; otherwise use the explicitly disclosed derived storage-plan area where the frozen geometry route supports it.
evaporation.advanced: stage-area surface curve may be used only as an explicitly selected advanced method.

governance_note: Formal HUF confirmation of expert-selected methodology positions remains a separate governance matter.
